capabilities: Sync Raindrop.io highlights and annotations into notes
Template note content, front matter, and filenames with Nunjucks
Manage which Raindrop collections get synced
Filter synced bookmarks with advanced search operators
Download full article content and embed attachments
disambiguation: One-way sync only: changes made in Obsidian, such as moving a file, are never pushed back to Raindrop.
extras: Token is stored in localStorage, which can conflict if the same vault is open in two windows. Raindrop API rate limit is 120 requests per minute and the plugin retries after hitting it. Annotations sync requires a Raindrop PRO subscription.
intentEvidence: This project is inspired by Hady Ozman's Obsidian Kindle Plugin and Wei Chen's Obsidian Hypothesis Plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to import highlights and annotations saved in Raindrop.io into vault notes.

summary: Raindrop.io sync plugin that pulls web article highlights and annotations into Obsidian notes, with templated output and one-way syncing.
